start: Progress photos with 2 or more photos

user_sees: 'Add a photo', 'Compare two photos', 'Share before and after'
Grid three to a row, newest first

steps.action: Tap 'Compare two photos', tap two photos
user_sees: 'Tap the first photo', then 'Now tap the second photo'

steps.action: Tap 'Add a photo', 'Choose from gallery', pick an undated photo
user_sees: 'It came without a date of its own, so it shows today until you pick one.'
must_not: A photo with no date shown as another day

start: No photos, or the camera refused

user_sees: 'Take one in the same spot and light every few weeks. Then compare any two side by side.'
must_not: Compare offered with fewer than 2 photos

steps.action: Refuse the camera, tap 'Take a photo'
user_sees: 'Camera not allowed. Allow the camera for MettleUp in your phone settings, or choose a photo from the gallery.'

start: A photo picked for compare, then deleted

steps.action: Open a photo, 'Delete photo', confirm 'Delete this photo?'
user_sees: The photo gone from the grid

steps.action: Open a saved compare of that photo
user_sees: 'One of these photos was deleted. Go back and pick two again.'

must_not: The next tap opens compare with an old pick

start: Member with photos, photo backup off then on

steps.action: Look at the subtitle, then turn on 'Include photos in my backup'
user_sees: Off: 'Private. They stay on this phone.'
On: 'Private. Your newest are in your phone’s backup too.'
must_not: Photos sent to MettleUp or the gym
Backup copies made while the switch is off
